supportName.description: The deployment's support-side display name. Default Support.

supportRole.description: What a support author is called as a person, beside a comment. Default Support.

house.description: Free text the system prompt carries as a section of its own, after the companion's method: who the support organization is, the deployment's knowledge sources and its tools' conventions. Appended as given, with no templating.

commands.description: Programs, beside the engine's own general-purpose ones, whose command lines an answer gives for someone to run, such as a product's CLI: a code span opening with one and holding arguments is an instruction, not a claim, and is not looked for in the evidence. A later layer's list replaces this one.

comments.description: The intentions for drafting case comments and the house style: the engine's base layer gives a general set, and a layer naming either replaces it whole.

style.description: The house style every draft is written in.

location.description: Where each case's store lives: home keeps it under the engineer's home directory (~/.compa/cases/<case>), private and safe for shared case folders (default); case keeps it in the case folder's .compa directory, falling back to home where there is no case folder.

homeRetentionDays.description: How long a case stored under the engineer's home directory is kept unused. Default 14.

vertex.description: Vertex AI settings for the vertex-gemini and vertex-anthropic providers, which use Application Default Credentials. An unset project falls back to GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT or ANTHROPIC_VERTEX_PROJECT_ID, and an unset location to GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOCATION or CLOUD_ML_REGION, then global.

cacheMinutes.description: How long an explicit Gemini cache of a request's stable prefix lives, in minutes; 10 when unset. Longer outlasts an engineer reading between calls, at Gemini's hourly storage charge, which the price table does not model.

openai.description: The OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions endpoint the openai provider calls, such as OpenRouter or a self-hosted inference server.

baseURL.description: The endpoint, up to /chat/completions; https://openrouter.ai/api/v1 when unset.

apiKeyEnv.description: The environment variable holding the endpoint's API key, sent as a bearer token; unset, no key is sent. The key itself is never configuration.

egressClass.description: Where the endpoint's calls go, which selects their redaction policy and is held against maxEgressClass: external_provider when unset. Declare internal_network or local_only only for an endpoint the deployment runs: local_only redacts nothing.

cacheMarks.description: Send the engine's cache breaks as Anthropic-style cache_control marks on message content, which OpenRouter passes to the models that take them. An endpoint that refuses the field must not set it.

profiles.description: Each task class's model (the companion's conversation and consults are class companion, the case ledger's calls class ledger, the editor's check of each answer class editor, which runs only where a profile names it, and the reviewer's second opinion on request class reviewer, offered only where a profile names it), by its name under models, and the effort its calls send: required where the model takes efforts, and one it lists; absent where it takes none.

models.description: The models the profiles use, by name: each one's provider, its model ID there, and the efforts it takes, as checked live. A model listing none is sent none.

barredAccounts.description: The deployment's list of accounts barred from AI processing: no model call is made for a case whose account is on it, and a case that cannot be checked is refused until the engineer overrides it. Unset, the rule is off.

list.description: The file: one account number a line, blank lines and # comments ignored.

overrideInstructions.description: Shown to the engineer before an override of a check that could not be made.

egressClass.description: How far a call's request may travel: the host alone, the deployment's network, or an external provider.
